action_history.rationale: Step 0 of 10 with only 8 data points spanning 6 dimensions — the GP is severely undersampled (ratio ~1.3 points per dimension). The surrogate cannot reliably identify promising regions yet. Using max_variance for 1-2 steps to strategically fill gaps in the input space, improving model fidelity before switching to log_ei for exploitation. Full budget available so early exploration investment is well justified.

Step 2 of 10, 9 remaining (90% budget). Still only 1.5 points per dimension in 6D — the GP is undersampled. Sobol indices show x1, x4, x5, x6 at zero sensitivity, but this is likely a data coverage artifact rather than true insensitivity. One final max_variance step to improve coverage in under-explored regions before switching to log_ei at step 3. Diagnostics passed cleanly, so model structure (kernel, noise) is kept as-is. This is the last planned exploration step — subsequent iterations will shift to log_ei for balanced exploitation.

Step 3 of 10, 8 remaining (80% budget). Transitioning from exploration to balanced optimization as planned. Switching from max_variance to log_ei — we've completed 2 exploration steps and need to start exploiting what we've learned. Critical fix: upgrading noise from min_noise_low to min_noise_med per diagnostic recommendation — LOO-CV residuals exceeded the 1σ band by 2.5-3×, indicating the GP is overfitting with the current noise floor. This likely contributed to the misplaced acquisition candidate in Step 2. The higher noise floor will regularize the GP mean, produce better-calibrated uncertainty estimates, and yield a more reliable acquisition landscape. Keeping matern_2.5 kernel and single_task surrogate as appropriate for the data size and smoothness characteristics observed so far.

Step 4 of 10, 7 remaining (70% budget). Optimization is progressing well — best y improved to -0.54 with consistent gains each step. No plateau detected, so no escalation needed. Continuing log_ei for balanced exploration/exploitation. The dramatic Sobol sensitivity shift between steps (x2-dominant → x5-dominant) indicates the GP is still resolving landscape structure with only 11 points in 6D; log_ei naturally handles this by balancing uncertainty and improvement. Keeping min_noise_med per Step 2 diagnostic fix — LOO-CV residuals improved. Kernel and surrogate unchanged as diagnostics passed and data size doesn't yet warrant DKL.

Step 5 of 10, 6 remaining (60% budget). Optimization is progressing well — best y improved to -0.54 with gains at every BO step, so no plateau escalation is warranted. The model has resolved the landscape structure: x5 and x6 are the dominant parameters with strong interaction, effectively reducing this to a 2D problem. log_ei will naturally concentrate sampling in the productive x5-x6 subspace while maintaining enough exploration to discover any remaining structure. Keeping min_noise_med (the Step 2 fix that improved LOO-CV calibration) and matern_2.5 kernel — diagnostics passed cleanly last step with this configuration. No changes to model structure needed; the current setup is well-calibrated and the acquisition function is correctly targeting high-improvement regions.

Step 5 of 10, 5 remaining (50% budget). Optimization is progressing well — best y = -1.24, a substantial improvement from initial data. No plateau detected, so no escalation needed. The GP is well-calibrated (diagnostics passed, LOO-CV acceptable) with min_noise_med providing appropriate regularization. Sobol analysis identifies x4, x5, x6 as the 3 active parameters with strong interactions (total Sobol ~1.49), effectively reducing the problem to 3D. log_ei will naturally balance exploitation of the promising region around the current best with exploration of the x4-x5-x6 interaction landscape. Maintaining the successful model configuration — matern_2.5 captures the smooth-but-varying landscape, and single_task is appropriate for 13 data points.

Best y improved to -1.24 last step — no plateau, so no escalation needed. However, diagnostics failed badly: LOO-CV residuals at points 9-13 reach 3×+ the uncertainty band (0.4-0.75 vs ~0.15-0.20), indicating the GP is overconfident with matern_2.5/min_noise_med. Following diagnostic recommendation: switching to matern_1.5 to capture rougher local structure (the dramatic Sobol sensitivity shifts across steps suggest aliased rough features), and min_noise_high to regularize and prevent overconfidence. This should produce better-calibrated uncertainty and a more reliable acquisition landscape. Continuing log_ei at 40% budget — optimization is progressing well and log_ei will naturally balance exploitation of the -1.24 region with exploration of the x4-x5 interaction landscape identified by Sobol analysis.

Budget = 3 remaining — must exploit. Best y = -1.24 with no plateau yet (only 2 steps without improvement). Diagnostics passed cleanly after switching to matern_1.5/min_noise_high last step, confirming the model is now well-calibrated — no reason to change a working configuration with so few experiments left. log_ei is the preferred exploitation-balanced strategy at this budget level and will target improvement over the current best. The unstable Sobol sensitivities across steps (reflecting 15 points in 6D) mean the GP is still resolving structure, making log_ei's natural uncertainty-awareness valuable — it will explore where the model is uncertain about improvement rather than committing blindly to any single parameter subspace.

Budget = 2 — must exploit aggressively. Best y = -1.24 has not improved in 5 steps, but budget rules take priority over plateau escalation. Using ucb with beta=0.3 to tightly exploit the region near the current best. The GP found -1.24 during what appears to be an exploratory sample, so the surrounding region likely has untapped potential. Keeping matern_1.5/min_noise_high which passed diagnostics last step — the rougher kernel better captures local structure in this 6D landscape with only 16 points, and the higher noise floor prevents overconfidence. No model changes warranted with so few experiments remaining.

LAST experiment — maximum exploitation required. Switching from matern_1.5/min_noise_high to matern_2.5/min_noise_low as diagnostics failed: large LOO-CV residuals (point 15 at ~3× band) indicate min_noise_high is attributing real signal to noise, preventing the GP from fitting the best region tightly. With min_noise_low, the GP can accurately resolve the landscape around y=-1.24, and matern_2.5 better captures the smooth interactions among x5, x1, x3 (total Sobol ~1.37). UCB with beta=0.1 provides near-pure exploitation, targeting the posterior mean minimum — our best chance to improve on -1.24 in this final shot.
